id./param/scenario/cs/a_100_cs_120.pack|cs_: "That thief! Sneaking into my precious orphanage to steal, what nerve! Once the tourney's over, I'll make him pay!
"Anyway, let's focus on tomorrow's match for now. ...Oh, right, {var:1}. It's late. Why don't you stay at our place tonight?
"Come on, don't be like that. We'll fight together tomorrow anyway, so it's more convenient. Don't be shy and stay.
"I'll wake you up tomorrow morning. Let's rest our bodies well for the final tournament.
